rows.transcript_1:
Here are five steps to Take A Pause: 

Step 1. Close your eyes and take a deep breath. 

Step 2. Ask yourself, "What am I thinking?" Notice if your thoughts are positive or negative.
Notice how you are feeling emotionally. Notice if your emotions are pleasant or unpleasant. Remind yourself that whatever you feel, it is okay.
Notice how your body feels. Notice anything that hurts or is tense.

Step 3. Focus on your breath. Feel your breath as it goes in and out. You can put a hand on your stomach and feel it rise and fall with each breath. Do this for about 10 breaths.

Step 4. Expand your awareness to your whole body. Listen to the sounds in the room. 

Step 5. Take a moment to reflect on whether you feel any different. When you are ready, open your eyes.

Well done for taking a pause. You can do this anytime you are feeling stressed. It gives you a chance to be calmer. Even a few deep breaths or connecting with the ground beneath you can make a difference. You can also take a pause with your children!
rows.transcript_2:
Ini merupakan 5 langkah untuk berhenti seketika:

Langkah pertama: Pejamkan mata dan tarik nafas dengan dalam.

Langkah kedua: Tanya diri anda, “Apakah yang sedang saya fikirkan?” Perhatikan sama ada fikiran itu positif atau negatif.
Perhatikan emosi anda. Adakah ia menyenangkan atau membimbangkan. Ingatkan diri anda bahawa apa pun yang anda rasa, semuanya adalah okey.
Perhatikan tubuh anda. Adakah ada bahagian yang sakit atau tegang.

Langkah ketiga: Tumpukan perhatian pada nafas anda dan rasainya. Anda boleh meletakkan tangan di perut dan rasa ia naik dan turun setiap kali anda bernafas. Lakukan langkah ini selama lebih kurang 10 kali.

[Berhenti selama 10 saat]

Langkah keempat: Luaskan perhatian anda kepada seluruh tubuh. Dengar bunyi-bunyi di sekeliling bilik.

Langkah kelima: Ambil sedikit masa untuk perhatikan sama ada anda rasa sedikit berbeza. Bila sudah bersedia, buka mata perlahan-lahan.

Syabas kerana mengambil masa untuk berhenti seketika. Anda boleh lakukan ini pada bila-bila masa anda rasa tertekan. Ia memberi ruang untuk anda menjadi lebih tenang.
Kadang-kadang, hanya dengan beberapa nafas yang dalam atau kembali berpijak ke bumi yang nyata pun sudah boleh membantu untuk menenangkan diri. Anda juga boleh lakukan berhenti seketika ini bersama anak-anak anda.

quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: All children develop at the same speed as each other.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
❌ That is incorrect.

✨ Each child is unique and will develop at their own pace. Some children may develop in some ways faster than others, while some may take more time.

💚 It is important that parents are patient and supportive, recognizing that every child has their own individual path of development. 

❗Remember that issues with your child’s development are not always obvious, and your child’s condition is NOT your fault.

🚩 If you have concerns about your child's development, you should consult with a professional to get support and advice.

quiz_2_question.eng: As children grow up, they may want to try new styles. How can you respond if your child expresses interest to suddenly change their dressing or hairstyle?

quiz_2_option_1_text.eng: Reject all their requests and say it is not necessary.

quiz_2_feedback_1.eng:
❌ Incorrect. 

💚 By warmly asking your child questions about their interests, they will feel comfortable sharing about the influences around them. 

🌷 You can gently give your opinions about their interests. 

⭐ You can also softly advise them on what changes fit your parenting values at home.

quiz_2_option_2_text.eng: Warmly ask more about what influenced their interest to change and why.

text_1_facilitator.eng:
At this stage, children start wanting more independence and trust. 🎈

They want to make their own choices and may answer back to show that they know the correct answers. 🎨⚽

At the same time, they will show emotions in their own unique ways. 😃😒😔😣

Here are some tips to support the healthy development of your child at this age. 💚

section_1_text.eng:
🎨 your child will want to spend time with other children. 
⚽ Support your child to make friends based on their interests - it’s great for them!
💚 Help your child learn about sharing and playing with others in a safe and fun way.

section_2_text.eng:
📖 your child might have favourite subjects in school. Encourage them to ask questions if something is hard! 
🌱 They may also be interested in religious matters or spirituality. You can support their curiosity!

section_3_text.eng:
📝 your child may begin making their own decisions and will want you to trust them. Listen to what they want and set rules that work for the family. 
🏆 Praise your child when they follow the rules!

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng: Great! 💙 Letting your child choose helps build confidence, independence, and curiosity as they grow.

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng: That's OK! It can be hard to find time. Even a short playtime where your child chooses the activity can make a big difference. You can set some time aside to play together tomorrow! 🌱
